title: Sexual Health Communication Skills Training Intervention for Patients With Prostate Cancer
official: Pilot Testing a Sexual Health Communication Skills Training Intervention for Patients With Prostate Cancer
summary: This is a pilot randomized controlled trial of a sexual health communication skills training multimedia intervention (Starting the Conversation \[STC\] adapted for patients with prostate cancer \[PCa\]) to improve patients' ability to communicate with providers about their sexual health concerns during PCa care compared to a time and attention control arm.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adult male with PCa at least 18 years of age
* Speak English
* Reside in the U.S.
* Have internet/web access, and
* Report current bother due to sexual dysfunction
* Capacity and willingness to provide consent
* Have an appointment with a PCa provider at NYU Langone Health during the study accrual period

Exclusion Criteria:

* Individual with impaired decision-making capacity.
* Participation in another part of this study (prior aim)
